description: Teaching schema for a compact Neo4j Movies-style graph used by hybrid RAG.
entity_extraction: The default graph_search implementation treats each node alias as a known entity phrase. If a question contains an alias, that alias is matched to the node label and searched over search_properties.

nodes.label: Person
nodes.description: Actor, director, or writer in the movie graph.

nodes.label: Movie
nodes.description: Movie title with release year and tagline.

nodes.label: Genre
nodes.description: Simple movie genre used for graph filtering and retrieval.

relationships.description: A person acted in a movie. The relationship may contain a role property.
A movie points to an actor. The relationship may contain a role property.
A movie points to one of its directors.
A movie points to one of its writers.
A movie belongs to a genre.
A movie points to one of its sequels.
A person points to an evidence document in resources/datasets/movies/documents.
A movie points to an evidence document in resources/datasets/movies/documents.
A genre points to an evidence document in resources/datasets/movies/documents.
